title: Deferred shutdown coordinator and resumable stream semantics for Go SDK
creator: Ava Johnson
description: Current Go SDK streaming clients use immediate context cancellation for client-initiated shutdowns which causes abrupt connection termination, wasted in-flight tokens, and poor ergonomics when composing per-message deadlines and retries. This ticket implements a ShutdownCoordinator that separates a 'soft shutdown' request from a forceful cancel, provides resumable stream tokens for transparent retry/resume, and offers ergonomic APIs that compose with context.Context and per-message deadlines. We will ship tests, examples, and a migration guide.
acceptance_criteria: Add ShutdownCoordinator type with RequestSoftShutdown(ctx, graceDuration) and ForceShutdown() methods
Expose StreamClient.StartStreamWithCoordinator(ctx, opts...) that registers stream handles with the coordinator
Resume semantics: client provides resumable checkpoint header and will attempt configurable resume attempts after transient network errors
Unit tests covering coordinator soft path, force path, resume success/failure, and per-message deadline propagation
Integration test with local server sim verifying no goroutine leaks after soft shutdown and aborted resumptions
Docs: migration guide and two idiomatic examples published to SDK docs
implementation_notes: RequestSoftShutdown signals components to stop accepting new user writes but allows existing in-flight operations to finish during graceDuration; coordinator triggers ForceShutdown when graceDuration expires
Coordinator tracks active work with an internal waitgroup and exposes Context() cancelled only on ForceShutdown to avoid immediate cancellation semantics
Resume token header (X-RW-Resume-Token) will be attached to stream checkpoints; client will attempt configurable resume attempts with exponential backoff on transient errors
Prefetch and KV cache adapters should register OnFlush hooks that are called on soft shutdown to flush within the grace window
New API is opt-in and designed to be a thin wrapper; existing simple StartStream remains unchanged for compatibility
Emit structured SDK logs for events: soft_shutdown_requested, soft_shutdown_expired, force_shutdown, resume_attempt, resume_success, resume_failure
Minimize allocations in hot path; coordinator should avoid per-token atomics and use lightweight handles
Resume tokens are ephemeral and do not contain secret material; rotate per session for safety
